description: Karte von der Eisenbahn zwischen Potsdam und Berlin, 1838 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. Die historische Karte - Eisenbahn zwischen Potsdam und Berlin - wurde von der Landesvermessung Brandenburg 1990 als Farb-Reproduktion herausgegeben. Die Originale liegen in der Staatsbibliothek Preußischer Kulturbesitz in Berlin. Im Querformat (43 x 28 cm) erhältlich zeigt die Karte die Lage der Eisenbahntrasse zwischen den Städten Potsdam und Berlin im Jahre 1838. Coverage: Open Data Brandenburg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are bodenbedeckung, historisch, karte, opendata, vermessung. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
